facts.text: Kaggle lists David Hartmann's ARC Prize 2025 entry as finished 2nd of 1,455 teams, with a gold medal icon, shown with the teammates insanitycheck and dfranzen.
His profile also lists AI Mathematical Olympiad - Progress Prize 3, finished 1,286th of 4,138 teams with no medal, again shown with insanitycheck and dfranzen.

His profile shows an active entry in ARC Prize 2026 - ARC-AGI-3, with 4 days to go when checked, alongside sbrodehl, insanitycheck and dfranzen. Public standings in that contest are provisional until it closes.
His Kaggle account dates from July 2025, and his featured write-up there is the ARChitects' ARC Prize 2025 solution, marked 2nd Place.

teamNotes: Every result above is a team result: both completed entries and the active ARC-AGI-3 entry show several accounts, and Kaggle's Activity box counts all 3 of his competitions as team entries. The ARC Prize 2025 gold medal belongs to the team (insanitycheck, dfranzen, dvhrtm) and must not be credited to him as an individual honour. The team name The ARChitects comes from the team's write-up, not from the Competitions list. His existing record already holds the ARC-3 roster membership on The ARChitects, which is not repeated here; the live list shows sbrodehl as a fourth account on the active entry.
